provenance.source: Factory direction v49 (product reality gate reopened) + the frozen four-question reality legs in product/product/reality_check.py at the accepted product packet (commit fdf1e386, results/product/reality_check/)
provenance.note: Evaluation-lane INDEPENDENT encoding of the observed reality-check failures. The same four questions and the same substantive assertions the product froze are re-owned here so the gate under test cannot weaken its own benchmark. Phrase gates are normalized NFKD/diacritic-stripped/casefolded exactly as the product normalizes them; the semantics are deliberately identical to the frozen product legs at freeze time.

latency_rule: a full run (one question: retrieval -> map -> sourced answer -> counter-authority pass) must complete in strictly less than 300s wall; >= 300s is rejected

accepted_answer_languages.rule: answer prose must be predominantly in the question's language, or in German (the product's frozen truth gates accept FR or DE phrasing); a predominantly non-Swiss answer (e.g. English) is wrong-language and is rejected

questions.question: Sous quelles conditions un bailleur peut-il résilier un bail d'habitation pour retard dans le paiement du loyer selon le droit suisse, et quelles exceptions ou limites jurisprudentielles existent ?

truth_gates.detail: missing Art. 257d(2) residential termination notice period

questions.question: La responsabilité pénale de l'entreprise selon l'art. 102 CP est-elle subsidiaire ou primaire, et pour quelles infractions ? Quelles exigences d'organisation doivent être prouvées ?

absent_any: ne cree pas une responsabilite primaire
truth_gates.detail: answer reverses the Federal Supreme Court's Art. 102(2) classification

questions.question: Dans quelles conditions le juge suisse s'abstient-il de revoir une décision commerciale d'un conseil d'administration au titre de la business judgment rule, et quelles exceptions ou limites ressortent de la jurisprudence ?
Un vol de faible valeur commis par un employé justifie-t-il un licenciement immédiat selon l'art. 337 CO ? Quelles circonstances font varier la réponse ?

truth_gates.detail: answer does not address the low-value fact pattern
